title: Explicit Picard pullback evaluation is perfect
statement: For a scheme map p:X→Y [def-pc-scheme] and finite locally free O_Y-module E [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], the explicit pairing on p^*E and p^*(dual E), constructed from the tensor comparison, pullback of dualEvaluation E and the canonical unit comparison [def-sc-picard-cup-product-map], has invertible curry.

source.place: final paragraph, perfect pairing and the two displayed mutually dual bases

proof.text: Finite local freeness makes E dualizable. Use the canonical exact pairing between E and its internal dual. Unfold sheafified evaluation and the sheafification adjunction to verify that its evaluation is precisely dualEvaluation E.

Ordinary monoidal pullback preserves this exact pairing. Transport it along picardTensorComparison on both factors. Its evaluation is the explicit pulled-back evaluation except for the choice of unit comparison.

The ratio between the monoidal unit isomorphism and the canonical pullback unit is an automorphism of O_X. Changing the evaluation by this automorphism changes its curry by the corresponding internal-Hom isomorphism. Hence the explicit pairing remains perfect. No nonempty basis or positive rank is used.

proof_origin.place: Refinement of the supplied local dual-basis plan; categorical transport and stalk argument
